thread:
alex: FYI - found OAuth tokens emitted in terraform-provider debug logs from a local run that got uploaded to our staging GCS bucket. Not public internet, but high blast radius. sample: ```2026-03-19T18:02:12Z DEBUG provider.oauth: token="ya29.a0AfH6S..." user=service-account-terraform@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com```
pradeep: ack. Where exactly in GCS? path + object? need to scope revoke quickly.
alex: bucket: gs://redwood-staging-terraform-logs/ci/2026-03-19/terraform.log.gz object is readable by staging-devs group.
sofia: blocking questions - was this logged by a provider plugin (third-party) or our wrapper? could be provider debug mode.
ajamie: (note: "jamie" is actually in the participants list; keep consistent) jamie: provider was `hashicorp/google` pinned to 4.2.0 on that workspace; local dev had TF_LOG=DEBUG set in their env.
pradeep: immediate actions: 1) revoke the OAuth client tokens / keys 2) rotate service account keys 3) tighten bucket ACLs 4) search for other occurrences. I'll take 1 & 2.
sofia: i'll handle #3 and run a quick gsutil search for `TF_LOG` artifacts and `ya29.` token patterns.
riley: add audit logging tasks: enable object-level audit for that bucket and export audit logs to sec-audit project for 90d retention. I'll file the ticket.
oncall: deploy-bot: triggered alert: instance-tag terraform-local-run matched file_upload rule.
deploy-bot: @eng-security incident created: INC-2026-0457 - terraform provider token exposure.
jamie: quick ask: does the service account in the token have broad roles? it was used for staging infra and has roles: roles/storage.objectAdmin, roles/compute.admin, roles/iam.serviceAccountUser. Not ideal.
pradeep: reduce blast radius: remove roles/compute.admin and replace with scoped roles for the workspace: roles/compute.viewer + specific instanceAdmin on staging-nodes. will submit IAM change and request approval.
sofia: notes on rotation: for OAuth client (3-legged) we need partner console rotate, for service account keys use `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create/ delete` and rewrap any Vault references with KMS after new key is uploaded.
alex: is Vault involved? the staging terraform stores creds in `secret/data/terraform/staging/sa-key` - looks like a local developer dump not the canonical Vault secret. We need to canonicalize.
pradeep: plan: 1) immediate revoke/delete leaked keys & OAuth tokens (30m) 2) rotate SA keys and push new key through Vault with kms-wrapping (1h) 3) update TF workspaces to use Vault dynamic SA creds or impersonation (2-3d) 4) RBAC cleanup and audit log config (3d)
sofia: I'm writing a short runbook for the oncall to follow. includes commands: ```# revoke oauth token - partner console (manual) # delete sa key gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=... # create new key gcloud iam service-accounts keys create key.json --iam-account=... # put into vault: vault kv put secret/terraform/staging/sa-key @key.json ``` and note: rewrap with KMS: `gcloud kms keys versions encrypt ...` (we'll script).
jamie: small follow-up: we should push a policy that disallows TF_LOG=DEBUG in CI and bans logs with `TF_LOG` env in uploader agents. I'll draft CI change.
pradeep: assigned tasks: pradeep -> revoke + rotate keys (doing now), sofia -> bucket ACL + search + runbook, jamie -> CI policy PR, riley -> audit export ticket + alert rule update, alex -> communication (internal owners + partner if needed).
sofia: communication: notify staging-apps and platform slack, include list of rotated credentials and service accounts. We should CC legal if partner data may be affected.
pradeep: done revoke for oauth client and deleted 2 SA keys. creating new keys now. new keys will be uploaded to Vault path `secret/terraform/staging/sa-key` and we'll enable KMS rewrap via `projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/terraform/cryptoKeys/sa-wrap`.
oncall: oncall: posting timeline to INC-2026-0457. ETA for completion ~ 70 minutes.
alex: quick detection follow-up: can we add a SCA (sensitive pattern detector) to scan uploads and block if matches `ya29\.|ya29_` or `-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----`?
sofia: yes, we'll add an uploader hook that rejects artifacts with those regexes and adds a `sensitive_detect` flag in metadata. I'll pair with riley on alerting.
riley: audit note: I'll add a daily search job for `TF_LOG` occurrences across our buckets for the next 14 days and surface any new hits to INC channel.
jamie: policy around RBAC: propose default dev service account role = storage.objectViewer + iam.serviceAccountUser impersonation for ephemeral operations. No long-lived keys for dev work.
pradeep: long term changes: 1) discourage long-lived keys - use workload identity + impersonation 2) vault canonicalization + KMS wrapping enforced by CI 3) block debug env in uploader/CI 4) runbook add revoke checklist + partner contact template.
alex: thanks all. I'll draft the incident note with scope & evidence and wrap up notifications. post the final incident summary to #incidents and attach the runbook.
sofia: runbook draft posted to INC-2026-0457 and PR with CI change targeting `staging` pipeline in 2 hours.
pradeep: new keys uploaded to Vault and rewrapped with KMS. rotated roles to reduce privileges. marking step complete.
alex: closing notes: no external disclosure required at this time; partners notified (if token belonged to external OAuth client) — partner said they rotated on their side. leaving the incident open for 48h monitoring. :thumbsup:
